candidates.statement: Gateway /v1/checkout returns 502 after ~2s because its call to order times out (transport ReadTimeout ~2s), and order's own calls to payment also time out at ~2s, propagating latency up to the gateway.
candidates.uncertainty: No payment/order service-side telemetry; cannot confirm which downstream hop is the true origin versus a timeout budget mismatch.

report.explanation: Traces and logs show checkout 502s driven by ~2s transport ReadTimeouts on gateway->order, with order->payment also timing out. Inventory/redis calls succeed quickly. Downstream latency is the best-supported bounded cause; service-side evidence for payment/order is missing.
missing_evidence: Payment service latency/error metrics and traces to confirm the origin of the ~2s ReadTimeout
Order service server-side logs/traces showing where its 2s timeout is spent
Timeout configuration values for gateway->order and order->payment calls
